tag: A Laminar Air Flow (LAF) Cabinet is a specialized laboratory workstation that uses a continuous, unidirectional flow of HEPA-filtered air to maintain a sterile, particle-free environment. It protects the sample or product inside the workspace from airborne contamination, though standard units do not protect the user from hazardous pathogens
